items.claim: Taimuraz was suspended for a tainted substance found in heart medication rather than steroids.
items.quote: he did get suspended for a tainted tainted supplement, but we're not talking steroids. It was something like in his heart medication.

items.claim: Taimuraz is a good fighter with a ton of experience who can find finishes and has solid wins.
items.quote: Taimuraz is a good fighter who can find finishes. He has a ton of experience, and he's got some good solid wins.

items.claim: Steve Erceg lacks good quality wins on his record.
items.quote: You know who does not have good wins? Steve Erceg.

items.claim: Steve Erceg is a decent wrestler who has added striking and possesses high fight IQ.
items.quote: Steve Erceg is a decent wrestler who has evolved, added some striking, and I think he's high IQ.

items.claim: Steve Erceg has been getting by largely on favorable matchups and his fight IQ.
items.quote: he's getting by with A, favorable matchups, and B, his fight IQ.

items.claim: Steve Erceg is vulnerable to being finished, having been knocked out by Kai Kara-France.
items.quote: Steve Erceg can be finished. We watched him get knocked out by Kai Kara-France.

items.claim: Steve Erceg has poor takedown defense.
items.quote: He just can't defend a freaking takedown.

items.claim: Magomed Ankalaev utilizes his length well, features good technical striking, forward pressure, and has wrestling as a backup plan.
items.quote: He's long, he uses length pretty well. He has wrestling as a backup plan. It is squarely plan B, not plan A. But he's a long dude. He's got good technical striking, good forward pressure.
